context:
Record each decision with chosen option, rejected option, and one sentence of rationale in the work-unit evidence. Where a decision reverses a documented contract (D1, D4, possibly D2), update docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md in the same change. Then unblock dependents.

D1/D2 gate rx-ux-11. D3/D4/D5 gate rx-ux-12 and everything downstream.
description:
Decision gate for the Results Explorer usability remediation sequence (plan v4). Five contract decisions must be recorded before any Phase 3 item starts. Three adversarial review rounds (codex, agy, grok) rejected earlier plans partly because these were treated as implementation details rather than documented-contract reversals.

D1 Default matrix mode. Recommendation: keep `times`, fix only the legend (rx-ux-04). Reversing the default changes what a shared link without `?mode=` renders.

D2 Ranked-scope default. Recommendation: do not collapse unranked platforms by default; offer a URL-persisted `ranked only` toggle. Collapsing reverses a stated product value and complicates the role=grid coordinate model (MetaLeaderboard.tsx:83,339,378).

D3 Picking vs compared state. Picking is four ephemeral useState Sets; compared is Compare's `?ids=` machine with async recovery. Recommendation: keep separate; give picking an in-memory owner; never URL-back it. URL-backing creates a global `?ids=` picking contract that cannot be retracted once copied into links.

D4 Compare's future. Recommendation: keep Compare as the comparison renderer and move candidate picking to Query.

D5 Corpus identity for stale-selection recovery. No snapshot-identity field exists today. Either always re-validate picked IDs against the live snapshot on load (no schema change), or add an identity field, which is a read-model v8 bump plus pipeline and build-contract changes. Recommendation: always re-validate.

Produces decisions only. Must not change application code.

anti_patterns.dont: start a Phase 3 item before D3, D4 and D5 are recorded
anti_patterns.why: plan v3 designed a selection owner against a snapshot-identity field that does not exist

anti_patterns.dont: treat the default matrix mode as a styling choice
anti_patterns.instead: treat it as a documented-contract reversal with a QA doc update
anti_patterns.why: results-explorer-qa.md S2.2 pins `times` as default and `?mode=` as URL state

anti_patterns.dont: write application code in this item
anti_patterns.why: mixing code into a decision gate makes the decision unrevertible

preserves.behavior: /results/compare?ids=<one> pins that run and opens the builder (Compare.tsx:184+); ?ids=<a,b> renders a comparison. Both are live contracts (ResultDetail.tsx:266, e2e/routes/compare.spec.ts:58, compare-entrypoints.spec.ts:76).
Read-model version 7 pin in _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/contract.py and results-explorer/src/db.ts (EXPECTED_READ_MODEL_VERSION), guarded by db-remediation-pin.test.ts.
Trust is per-result. hosted-results-contract.md:687-698 forbids an aggregate trust badge on a mixed-trust set.
docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md S2.2 pins three matrix modes with `times` as default and `?mode=` as URL state.

work_units.evidence: D1 DECIDED: default the cross-benchmark matrix to speedup mode. Rejected: keep times. Rationale: one reading rule across the grid (1.00x is the ranking best, worse below it) removes the mixed-direction problem at its source. This REVERSES the documented default in docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md S2.2, so that doc must change in the same PR and shared links without ?mode= will render speedup. Data verified sufficient: speedup_vs_best is populated for every ranking-eligible row (9/9 asc, 6/6 desc). Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Record D1 default matrix mode with rationale

work_units.evidence: D2 DECIDED: collapse platforms with no ranked evidence by default, with a 'N more platforms have published results but nothing ranked - Show them' expander. Rejected: keep all visible with a ranked-only toggle; show everything with no toggle. Consequence: rx-ux-11 w3 is in scope, and the spanning collapsed row REQUIRES explicit focusPos handling in MetaLeaderboard's role=grid arrow-key model (MetaLeaderboard.tsx:83,339,378). Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Record D2 ranked-scope default with rationale

work_units.evidence: D3 DECIDED: keep picking state and compared state separate. Picking gets one in-memory owner with tab lifetime, never URL-backed; Compare's ?ids= is untouched; buildCompareUrl is the seam. Rejected: a single global URL-backed ?ids= selection, because it cannot be retracted once shared and collides with route-specific query state. sessionStorage carries picking across the Pages 404 restore hop only. Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Record D3 picking vs compared state model

work_units.evidence: D4 DECIDED: Compare stays the comparison renderer; candidate picking moves to the paged Query table. Rejected: retire Compare entirely; leave Compare as-is. rx-ux-19 retires only the candidate table, behind the ten-case parity gate, and ?ids= deep links including the single-ID pin keep working. Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.

D5 DECIDED: always re-validate picked IDs against the live snapshot on load, reusing Compare's async recovery. Rejected: add a snapshot-identity field, which would require a read-model v7->v8 bump plus pipeline, build-contract and browser-pin changes. Read-model stays at version 7. Cost: one async round trip per hydrate. Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.

DISCHARGED BY DELEGATION, not by editing here. Two decisions reverse documented contracts and both need a code+doc change in one PR, which requires a linked worktree and is out of a decision gate's remit: (a) D1 reverses the S2.2 default from times to speedup - owned by rx-ux-23, whose w3 and its fourth verification assert the doc and the implemented default agree; (b) D2 reverses the ranked-scope default to collapse-by-default - owned by rx-ux-11. No documentation was edited under this gate; git status for the repo confirms no working-tree change. Recorded 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Update results-explorer-qa.md for any contract-reversing decision

work_units.evidence: D6 DECIDED: adopt viewport-fit=cover. Rejected: leave the safe-area seam inert. Consequence: this is a global layout-viewport change affecting every route, so it is NOT folded into rx-ux-01 (which keeps its inert-seam scope and its do-not-modify rule on index.html). Adoption plus the full responsive re-check is owned by a separate item, rx-ux-24. Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Record D6 whether to adopt viewport-fit=cover (global layout consequence) or leave the safe-area seam inert

work_units.evidence: D7 DECIDED: the selection tray names each selected run's trust individually; no aggregate trust badge or mixed-provenance summary. Rejected: a neutral mixed-provenance note (risks reading as the aggregate judgement the contract prohibits); saying nothing until the comparison view. Complies directly with hosted-results-contract.md:687-698. Decided by repository owner, 2026-08-22.
work_units.summary: Record D7 what the selection tray may state about a mixed-trust set, given hosted-results-contract.md forbids an aggregate trust badge
